name: National Scholarship Portal - Post-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC/EBC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
description: A central scholarship scheme for SC, ST, OBC, and EBC students studying from Class 11 onwards (including diploma, undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD programmes), covering maintenance allowance and compulsory institutional fees.
benefits: Maintenance allowance (approx. Rs. 230-820/month depending on day-scholar or hosteller status) plus full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable institutional fees; amounts and ceilings vary by category, with SC/ST students eligible for up to Rs. 2.5 lakh/year and OBC up to Rs. 1.5 lakh/year in tuition support. Paid via DBT to the Aadhaar-linked bank account through PFMS.
eligibility: Student must belong to SC, ST, OBC, or EBC category
Enrolled in a recognised post-matric course from Class 11 onwards, including diploma, undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD programmes
Family income must be within the scheme's prescribed ceiling (varies by category)
Must complete One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar and face authentication on NSP
Scholarship must be renewed each academic year; not automatically continued
documents_required: Institution admission/bonafide certificate and fee receipt
how_to_apply: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar and mobile number on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in), select the relevant Post-Matric scheme, fill in institutional and course details, and submit for institute and state verification. Renewal is required every academic year.
